stale pod binds → unrouted VM

terminating or
missing uid / sandbox id / generation?

span.p:
Batched Postgres classify
ANY($1): lifecycle + active generation
(excluding deleted tombstones)

span.p:
Skip: row restoring, other transient,
quarantined, or unrecognized

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Skip: pod gen ≥ active gen
(live runtime, re-drive adoptable,
same-gen orphan → suspend subsystem),
or no active execution outside suspended/failed

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Orphan: row deleted,
suspended/failed with no active execution,
or pod gen < active gen

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
continuously orphaned
≥ threshold (5m)?
(clock resets on cold cache / DB outage / restart)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Verify: cache-bypassing pod GET
(same UID, restore marker, sandbox, generation)
+ authoritative Postgres recheck

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Metric mode:dry_run + log, once per pod
no delete, no sandbox event

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
cleanup_requested → DELETE
preconditions: UID + resourceVersion
no DB lock held
→ requested_orphaned_restore_pod_delete

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
later ticks: pod still
in the cache?

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
terminating ≥ 5m and confirmed by a fresh GET:
teardown_stuck + cleanup_failed
(re-read until it settles)

cleanup_failed, retry next tick
